    Information

    [edit]

    Format

    [edit]
    • Regular Season
      • Single Round Robin
      • All teams advance to Playoffs, Regular Season decides seeding for Playoffs
      • All matches are Bo5.
    • Playoffs : February 28th - March 27th, 2024
      • Double Elimination bracket
      • All matches (excl. Grand Finals) are Bo5
      • Grand Finals are Bo7

    Broadcast Talent

    [edit]
    • Commentators:

      •  Gio (Giovanni Citti)
    • Observer:
      •  Maddantekiller
